title: Conditional κ = 0.000752893499605334868002344: source-bound w3 word and complete finite admission (+0.1855% over #309)
body:
The supplied w3 word improves the exact conditional exponent to

    κ = 94111687450666858500293 / 125000000000000000000000000
      = 0.000752893499605334868002344.

This is **0.18551765% above PR #309** at its checked head `19d148bd7aa199378816cf1fb9ff746eb4d815da`, and 3.96366336% above #280. These are improvements in the conditional asymptotic exponent, not measured multiplication speed.

The cube-layer/twin/line-pair word is preserved exactly from the supplied archive. This package completes its source binding, bank allocation, rational frame and changed-projector charts, finite costs, and stronger complex-supplier admission:

- Freshly regenerate and fully replay PR249/source527 and PR256/PR233, retaining original source pins, licenses and notices.
- Prove 1,455 freed helpers absent from every record; independently check all original and compact physical F₂ columns, leaving 15,132 active helpers.
- Admit 3,473 new frames, 20,844 changed projector charts and 3,026,400 concrete role/replica/stage bank assignments. Exact width-120 packing gives normalized stock 162,123; retain conservative normalizer 787.
- Expand the PR233 supplier's coefficients through paid signed additions, with 40 exact recipe checks, and recompute scalar, scratch, splice, routing, precision and physical-row bounds.
- Check the complete finite invoice, exact fixed-prime fallback, two rational moment engines, eight positive-gap ordinary levels and all 47 strict assembly inequalities. The adjacent 10^-27 grid point is rejected.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.11+, C++17 and Boost:

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/w3-bitword/requirements.txt
python -B research/w3-bitword/verify.py --output /tmp/w3-proof
```

Every prerequisite and extension stage runs fresh; no saved PASS receipt substitutes for execution. The full local replay passed in 297 seconds. Package hashes are checked before and after execution. The full final committed package also passed a fresh Linux/Python 3.11/g++ replay in [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/utcorvusvolat-dotcom/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38058125719), including its final manifest and both prerequisite source verifiers.

The claim remains conditional on the inherited all-size compiler, common weighted charts, restored rows, selectors, routing, prime supply, complex dirty lifting, precision/recovery and analytic transfer interfaces. This is not a new Lean certificate, an unconditional multiplication theorem or a practical speed benchmark. See README.md, PROOF.md, SOURCE.json and NOTICE.md for the exact boundary and provenance. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
